title: UK to Invest £100m in New AI Biosecurity Lab
excerpt: The UK government plans to fund a new AI Biosecurity Lab with £100 million to strengthen national security defenses.
body_html:
The UK government is set to invest £100 million to establish a new artificial intelligence biosecurity laboratory described as a world first. The funding is part of a broader spending announcement revealed by the chancellor ahead of the upcoming Budget.

According to the details, the financial commitment is specifically aimed at shoring up the nation's defenses against emerging risks related to artificial intelligence. Further specifics regarding the operational timeline or exact location of the lab were not detailed in the initial announcement, but the investment highlights a growing focus on AI safety and national security measures.
